title: NHK Eテレ — ピタゴラスイッチ (Pythagora Switch)
description: NHK Eテレ's beloved children's educational programme Pythagora Switch (ピタゴラスイッチ), broadcast since 2002. Each episode features chain-reaction 'Pythagorean device' machines, short songs, and simple science/logic concepts. Narrated in very clear N5-level Japanese ideal for children and beginner adult learners.
creator: NHK Eテレ
